articles.title: Is Genting Singapore (SGX:G13) Stock Looking Fully Valued On Dividends?
articles.summary: Genting Singapore has seen its share price slide in recent years, yet the stock still pays out a recurring stream of dividends. That mix of weaker returns and ongoing income puts the spotlight on a single issue for investors: whether today's valuation is properly supported by the cash those dividends represent. Over the past 3 years the share price has fallen 24.7%, which raises the question of whether the market is now placing a different value on Genting Singapore's future dividend...
